title: Bioinformatics Scientist II
description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

  • We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
  • We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
  • We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
  • We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

We are seeking a motivated and scientifically rigorous Bioinformatics Scientist II to contribute to the development of next-generation minimal residual disease (MRD) laboratory-developed tests (LDTs). This role will support assay development efforts through bioinformatics analysis, experimental design, data interpretation, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate is an early-career scientist with a strong foundation in genomics, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS). Candidates may be recent Ph.D. graduates or individuals with 1 to 3 years of postdoctoral or industry experience. The successful candidate will be a creative problem solver, critical thinker, and collaborative scientist who enjoys working at the interface of computational biology and laboratory assay development.

Key Responsibilities

Bioinformatics Analysis & Assay Development

  • Contribute to the design, development, evaluation, and optimization of NGS-based MRD assays.
  • Perform bioinformatics analyses to support assay development, analytical validation, and performance characterization studies.
  • Analyze and interpret complex genomic datasets and communicate findings to project teams.
  • Develop and maintain reproducible analysis workflows and scripts for assay development activities.
  • Support evaluation of assay performance metrics, including sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, reproducibility, and quality control metrics.
  • Participate in benchmarking studies to evaluate and compare bioinformatics methods and analytical approaches.

Experimental Design & Scientific Problem Solving

  • Collaborate with wet-lab scientists to design experiments, analyze results, and drive data-informed decisions.
  • Apply critical thinking and scientific reasoning to investigate assay performance, troubleshoot challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Contribute to the development of novel computational approaches and analytical methods as needed.
  • Document analyses, methods, and study results in a clear and reproducible manner.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with assay development, molecular biology, software engineering, biostatistics, clinical, and quality teams to support program objectives.
  • Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and project planning activities.
  • Help translate biological and technical questions into computational analyses and actionable recommendations.
  • Communicate results effectively to both computational and non-computational audiences.

Quality & Documentation

  • Follow established quality systems and development processes for regulated diagnostic assay development.
  • Contribute to study documentation, development reports, validation summaries, and technical records.
  • Support preparation of materials for regulatory submissions, audits, and design-control activities as appropriate.

Who You Are:

Required Qualifications

  • D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Biomedical Engineering, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Recent Ph.D. graduate and 2+ years of postdoctoral and/or industry experience or M.Sc and 5+ years of experience.
  • Strong understanding of molecular biology, genetics, and next-generation sequencing technologies.
  • Experience analyzing NGS data and developing computational workflows using Python and/or R.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex datasets and draw scientifically sound conclusions.
  • Strong critical thinking, quantitative reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.
  • Demonstrated scientific curiosity, initiative, and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting development of NGS-based research or diagnostic assays.
  • Familiarity with cancer genomics, somatic variant analysis, and liquid biopsy applications.
  • Experience working with cell-free DNA (cfDNA) or circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) datasets.
  • Knowledge of bioinformatics best practices, reproducible research methods, and software version control tools.
  • Experience with cloud computing environments (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
  • Exposure to regulated product development environments, including CAP/CLIA, FDA, or IVD development processes.
  • Experience collaborating closely with both laboratory and computational scientists.

What Success Looks Like

  • Demonstrates strong scientific judgment and analytical rigor.
  • Develops a deep understanding of assay biology, experimental design, and data interpretation.
  • Contributes high-quality analyses that inform key development decisions.
  • Builds effective partnerships across wet-lab and computational teams.
  • Continuously learns new technologies, methods, and scientific domains.
  • Grows toward increasing technical ownership and leadership within assay development programs.

#LI-Hybrid, or #LI-Remote

For candidates based in our San Diego office, the range is $134,000 - $166,000.

For candidates based in our South San Francisco office, the range is $152,000 - $170,000.

For candidates working remote (US), the range is $122,000 - $158,000.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Pay range

$122,000—$170,000 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.

About Veracyte

Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. For more information, please visit www.veracyte.com or follow us on LinkedIn or X (Twitter).

Veracyte, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability status. Veracyte participates in E-Verify in the United States. View our CCPA Disclosure Notice

If you receive any suspicious alerts or communications through LinkedIn or other online job sites for any position at Veracyte, please exercise caution and promptly report any concerns to careers@veracyte.com

title: Integration Engineer, ERP
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers' ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for our customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You'll take ownership of integrations across ERPs such as Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor, IFS and abas, and help us connect to the next one.

 

What you’ll do

  • Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, OData, direct DB access and file transfers.

  • Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

  • Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

  • Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, documentation and driving improvements to ensure market fit, reliability and efficient installation.

  • Enable technical project managers and integration specialists to consult on, install and configure existing integrations.

 

What you'll bring

  • Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go fast, that works for us.

  • Hands-on integration experience with at least one ERP system (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor, IFS, ABAS or similar), ideally more than one. You have built or maintained native interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

  • A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have:

  • Experience writing production code in Go.

  • Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

  • A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in ERP systems: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

  • Experience with both cloud and on-premise ERP environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access or API rate limits in cloud ERPs).

Why BLP

  • Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

  • Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

  • Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

  • Team: regular team events.

Practical information

  • Location: We have an office in Zurich, London, Munich and Cologne, hybrid with 3+ office days per week in those locations or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

  • If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

  • Employment: full-time, permanent.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

title: hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG
description:
hbo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden?
Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG).

Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen.

Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid.

Je onderzoekt onder andere:

  • Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties?

  • Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG?

  • Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen?

Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt.

Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed en de woningmarkt.

We maken statistieken over (bouw)vergunningen, ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad, (gemiddelde) WOZ-waardes, eigendomsverhoudingen, tijdelijke woningen, woningtransformaties en nog heel veel meer. We doen statistisch onderzoek op verzoek van organisaties in de publieke sector. En we beheren en verwerken data voor CBS-collega’s en werken samen met diverse organisaties, waaronder het Kadaster, de ministeries van BZK, VRO en EZK en Eurostat.

We publiceren regelmatig over de dynamiek van de Nederlandse vastgoed- en woningmarkt. Onze nieuwsberichten halen regelmatig journaals, nieuwssites en voorpagina’s van landelijke dagbladen. En daar zijn we trots op!

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een hbo opleiding in de studierichting toegepaste wiskunde, data science of sociale wetenschappen.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met de woningmarkt.

  • Je hebt kennis en wellicht ervaring met R/rmarkdown en/of Python en SQL databases. 

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast om met data aan de slag te gaan.

  • Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te ontdekken, neemt graag initiatief en denkt actief mee.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook graag de samenwerking op.

  • Je deelt gemakkelijk je ideeën en bevindingen en staat open voor nieuwe inzichten en feedback.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • samenwerkt met ervaren experts binnen hun vakgebied;

  • gaat werken met grote databases (SQL);

  • kennis opbouwt van de BAG en het registratieproces bij bronhouders;

  • analyses samenvat in data visualisaties en overzichtelijke tabellen.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

title: Cloud Engineer Automation
description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! 

 

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform.

 

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing  #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday!


Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!


The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. 

This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates.
  • Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports
  • Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback.
  • Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved.
  • Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO.
  • Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches.
  • Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling.
  • Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained.
  • Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. 
  • Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code.
  • Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work
  • Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library.
  • Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them.
  • Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it.


Requirements:
  • 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. 
  • Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). 
  • Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring.
  • Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS.
  • Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce.

title: Product Owner, AI Pod
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Product Owner (Contractor) for two AI Pods that build the foundations of Numa, Enumerate’s AI product line, including Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist. This role is focused on execution, not product strategy or roadmap direction. The Product Owner will own and detail the AI Pod backlog, lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for every release, document test findings clearly, and analyze customer usage and metrics to inform what gets built next. The role reports to the Director of Product Management and works closely with Product Managers and Engineering. This is a strong fit for someone with a QA background who has recently moved into a product role and wants to grow in product management working on live, customer-facing AI products.

This is a remote contractor opportunity for candidates located in LATAM who are comfortable working in an English-speaking professional environment.

Key Responsibilities

Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution

  • Own, detail, and manage the delivery backlog for the two AI Pod teams
  • Translate defined product priorities into detailed user stories, functional requirements, and testable acceptance criteria
  • Break down initiatives into well-scoped epics, stories, and tasks with clear definitions of ready and done
  • Keep backlog items refined, prioritized, and ready for development ahead of each sprint
  • Work with other Product Managers and Product Owners whose features depend on the AI Pods to validate requirements and sign-off
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives
  • Partner with Engineering to clarify scope, remove blockers, and escalate dependencies and risks

User Acceptance Testing & Quality Validation

  • Plan and conduct UAT for AI Pod deliverables and provide release sign-off
  • Create and maintain UAT plans, test scenarios, and test cases tied to acceptance criteria
  • Perform functional, regression, and edge-case testing on completed stories and features before release
  • Validate AI output quality for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, including accuracy, relevance, consistency, and exception handling, using repeatable test prompts and evaluation sets
  • Log, document, and prioritize defects, and verify fixes before closing

Documentation of Findings

  • Document UAT results, defects, and AI output evaluation findings in a clear, structured, repeatable format
  • Produce release-level test summaries covering what was tested, results, known issues, and recommended follow-ups
  • Maintain up-to-date user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, and supporting documentation
  • Provide Product Marketing with feature details and release information needed for go-to-market materials

Customer Usage & Metrics Analysis

  • Own product analytics for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, including adoption, usage, and engagement metrics
  • Analyze usage patterns, customer questions, and feedback to identify friction points, gaps in AI responses, and improvement opportunities
  • Build and maintain recurring usage and metrics reporting for product leadership
  • Turn findings into backlog items and use data to inform prioritization

AI & Automation Workflow Enablement

  • Analyze and document end-to-end workflows suitable for AI-driven automation
  • Turn tasks users currently perform manually into clear requirements Engineering can build from
  • Define business rules, inputs, outputs, dependencies, and exception handling
  • Ensure workflows are well-documented and testable

Required Qualifications

  • Background in QA or software testing (manual and/or automated), with recent hands-on experience (roughly 1–3 years) as a Product Owner, Associate Product Manager, or Business Analyst on a software product
  • Strong UAT experience: writing test plans and test cases from acceptance criteria, executing functional, regression, and edge-case testing, and giving release sign-off
  • Experience writing detailed user stories and testable acceptance criteria and managing a backlog in Jira or a similar tool within an Agile/Scrum team
  • At least some hands-on experience with AI products, such as working on, testing, or supporting an LLM-powered assistant, chatbot, or AI feature
  • Working understanding of LLMs, including why outputs vary, common failure modes such as hallucination and inconsistency, and how to test and evaluate AI output quality
  • Analytical by nature: comfortable pulling and interpreting product usage data and turning findings into clear recommendations
  • Clear, structured written documentation that others can act on without a walkthrough
  • Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken

Nice to Have

  • B2B SaaS experience, ideally vertical SaaS, proptech, or FinTech/Payments
  • Experience evaluating conversational AI output in a structured way (prompt test sets, evaluation rubrics, regression testing for AI)
  • Experience with product analytics tools (e.g., Pendo, Mixpanel, Amplitude) and basic SQL
  • Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones
  • Familiarity with property management, HOA/community association, or accounting workflows

About Us

Enumerate is a leader in the property management space offering a robust ERP system called Central that delivers Community Accounting, Management, Communications, Engagement, and Reporting all on one easy-to-use platform. It is the most comprehensive solution for property management, powerful enough to support large scale Property Managers, yet easy enough for Self-Management Associations.

At Enumerate, we put the Customer First in everything we do, delivering customer-centric solutions and finding ways to say YES. We have an incredible team atmosphere where egos don’t exist, and we credit others for contributions, accomplishments, and success.

Total monthly compensation:

$2,700—$3,300 USD

title: Enterprise Architect (Pre-Sales)
description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

You will be part of the founding Enterprise Architecture team, standing up the function end-to-end: the playbooks, the reference architectures, the technical discovery motion, and the deal patterns that every future EA will inherit.

You’ll personally engage in our most strategic pursuits, ensuring Zip’s platform meets the functional and technical requirements of prospects. You’ll work directly with the Global SE leader and partner with Sales, Solution Engineering, and Product to evangelize Zip into the world’s most iconic brands

What you’ll do

  • Win the deals that define the region: Act as the senior technical voice on strategic pursuits - leading discovery with customer CTOs, CIOs, and Chief Procurement Officers, and closing the architectural gap between their landscape and Zip.

  • Build the EA function: Create the foundational assets - customer system landscape templates, reference architectures, integration capability matrices, security & compliance packets, objection response libraries - and set the bar for how EA shows up in deals.

  • Own the system integration narrative: Lead the technical story on how Zip integrates with SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, Ariba), Oracle, Workday, Netsuite, Coupa, and adjacent systems. You are responsible for translating the customer landscapes into credible integration plans using our proprietary middleware.

  • Bridge GTM and Product: Translate customer requirements into clear product inputs. Influence roadmap prioritization with evidence, not opinion.

  • Enable the field: Coach Solution Engineers and Account Executives on technical positioning, objection handling, and executive-level architectural conversations.

Qualifications

  • 15+ years in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, pre-sales engineering, or product roles at B2B SaaS, iPaaS, or ERP / system-of-record vendors

  • Deep domain knowledge: Knowledgeable about the full intake-to-pay lifecycle and how data moves between systems

  • Strong command of the ERP ecosystem: You understand APIs, data models, and integration patterns across SAP (Ariba, S/4HANA, ECC), Oracle, Workday, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, and others

  • Hands-on fluency with integration architecture and middleware: iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato), REST APIs, event-driven patterns, ETL

  • Proven success selling into or implementing at Fortune 500 customers

  • Track record of owning security reviews and PoCs at enterprise scale

  • Comfort operating as the senior technical voice in a room with CIOs, CFOs, and CPOs

Nice to have

  • Experience standing up a function, team, or regional practice from the ground up

  • Experience at a category-defining, high-growth SaaS company or Big 4 Consulting Experience

  • TOGAF Certified

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Health, vision & dental coverage options

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 🏋️‍♀️ ClassPass membership

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 💻 Home office stipend

  • 🛜 Phone/internet reimbursement

  • 🍼 Paid parental leave

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Network Production Engineer
description:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate

  • Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

  • Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

  • Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

  • Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

  • Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Production Engineering Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

  • Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10s of GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.

  • Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up.

  • Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s of GW next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

Role Scope

  • Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers.

  • Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours.

  • Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs.

  • Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in.

  • Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.

  • You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it.

  • You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution.

  • You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone.

  • You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet.

  • You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again.

  • You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero.

  • Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling.

Salary & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

  • Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.

Bei care bauen wir die Plattform, mit der Menschen ihre Gesundheit langfristig managen. Du baust die Growth-Maschine dahinter: von der ersten Ad bis zur CRM-Journey nach dem Check-up, mit AI als wichtigstem Werkzeug.

Was uns wichtiger ist als jeder Lebenslauf: Neugier, Hunger und unternehmerisches Denken.

Deine Aufgaben im Traineeship

  • Aufbau von AI-Workflows, Agenten und Automationen für Marketing, Sales und Operations, mit geeigneten Sprachmodellen, AI-Tools für Automatisierung oder direkt über APIs

  • Vibe Coding von internen Tools, Landingpages und Prototypen, die uns schneller machen

  • Paid Ads auf Meta und Google: vom Briefing über AI-gestützte Creatives bis zu Testing und Auswertung

  • Skalierung unserer Creative-Produktion mit AI: mehr Varianten, schnellere Tests, dreisprachig

  • SEO und GEO: unsere Sichtbarkeit in Google und in AI-Suchen wie ChatGPT oder Perplexity, inklusive AI-gestützter Content-Produktion

  • Analyse und Optimierung von Funnels und Landingpages mit A/B-Tests

  • Automatisierte CRM-Journeys in unserem CRM-Tool: Onboarding, Reminder, Nachkontrollen, Reaktivierung

  • Interesse an künstlicher Intelligenz, Datenanalyse und Wachstum im Tech- und Gesundheitssektor

  • Du bist neugierig: du willst verstehen, wie Dinge funktionieren, und probierst neue Tools als Erste:r aus

  • Du bist hungrig: du willst Verantwortung, Tempo und eine steile Lernkurve

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch: du wartest nicht auf Anweisungen und misst dich am Impact

  • Erfahrung mit Python, JavaScript, SQL, APIs, CRM-Tools, Mixpanel, GA4, Meta Ads Manager oder Google Ads von Vorteil

Benefits

  • Echte Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag und direkter Draht zum Gründerteam

  • Arbeiten mit den neuesten AI-Tools, Neues darfst du jederzeit ausprobieren

  • Einblick in den ganzen Funnel eines Startups im Gesundheitsmarkt, inklusive Kommunikation in einem regulierten Umfeld

  • Flache Hierarchie, schnelle Entscheidungen, wenig Meetings

  • Zentrale Lage im Herzen der Stadt Zürich, kombiniert mit hybridem Arbeiten und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten

  • Kostenloser Zugang zur modernsten Gesundheitsplattform der Schweiz

  • Option auf Festanstellung nach dem Traineeship

  • 2'250 CHF pro Monat ohne Abschluss, 2'500 CHF mit Bachelorabschluss, 2'750 CHF mit Masterabschluss (bei 100%)

  2. Zwei, drei Sätze: Welchen Prozess bei care würdest du als Erstes automatisieren, und warum?

Wir glauben an schnelles Lernen, mutiges Experimentieren und tägliche Umsetzung statt endloser Meetings und Perfektionismus.

description:
About AMBOSS

We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

Position Summary

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.

Responsibilities Include

  • Identifying high-yield ABOG exam topics and gaps in Qbank question coverage

  • Helping define what makes a high-quality board-style question

  • Reviewing questions to assess how well they match the ABOG exam in format, content, and difficulty

  • Evaluating whether questions and explanations are clear, concise, and useful for board preparation

  • Suggesting specific changes to improve questions and their educational value

  • Sharing insights from OB-GYN residency training and board preparation with other teams

Qualifications

  • Medical degree (MD/DO).

  • Current PGY-4 resident or recent graduate of an ACGME-accredited OB-GYN residency program in the U.S.

  • Familiarity with the ABOG Qualifying Examination and OB-GYN board preparation resources

  • Strong clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and written communication skills

  • Ability to provide clear, practical feedback focused on educational value

  • Comfortable working independently and meeting agreed-upon deadlines in an asynchronous remote environment

  • Preferred (not required): Experience with AI and/or LLM applications

Logistics

  • Position type: Freelance, independent contractor (project-based)

  • Location: Fully remote

  • Duration: 3 months (~5â10 hours/week, as needed)

  • Schedule: Flexible and project-based, with agreed-upon turnaround times

  • Compensation: $75-$100/hr for current residents; $100-120/hr for recent graduates and attendings

  • Start date: As soon as possible

Why join us?

  • Use your medical training and board preparation experience to help shape the future of residency education and board preparation.

  • Contribute to the quality and responsible use of AI-powered medical education.

  • Explore meaningful nonclinical work that complements your clinical training or practice, with flexible, fully remote part-time hours.

We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care!

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

Waar jij het verschil maakt

De IT producten waar je aan werkt dragen bij aan statistieken over de bouw, industrie, transport, de zakelijke dienstverlening en bijvoorbeeld de motor- en autohandel.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor IT vakmanschap in het team te brengen, en daarmee bestaande en nieuwe IT producten te ontwikkelen en onderhouden. Ook heb je contacten met gebruikers en werk je samen in en soms buiten je team. Je werkt in een team met een agile werkwijze waar ieder teamlid onder meer een verantwoordelijkheid heeft in het continu verbeteren en leren.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je team bestaat uit een PO, gedeelde Scrum master en in totaal vijf gedreven developers. Ze werken graag samen op kantoor en lopen een rondje buiten in de pauzes. Op maandagen en dinsdagen zijn de vaste team kantoordagen. Sommige collega’s werken vaker op kantoor.


Dit ben jij

Je bent een ervaren developer met een flexibele instelling. De context van het werk binnen het team vragen om het willen leren en openstaan voor nieuwe ontwikkelingen. Om meteen aan de slag te kunnen gaan beschik je over het volgende profiel:

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met .Net (Core) en C# en 3 jaar met Angular, Typescript, HTML en CSS;

  • 3 jaar ervaring met SQL (MS SQL Server) en Git;

  • Ervaring met CI/CD pipelines (Azure Devops), kennis van Kubernetes en containerisation;

  • Vaardig met het kunnen ontwikkelen in een omgeving waarbij de toegang tot generatieve AI vooralsnog afgeschermd is;

  • Ervaring met Python, .Net Framework en Powershell zijn een pre.

Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.

title: Data Analist (NL)
description:
Bouw mee aan onze nieuwe propositie en maak commerciële impact!

Bij YoungOnes staat data aan de wieg van elk besluit. Ons Data & RevOps team zit aan elke tafel en heeft een leidende rol in de koers van het bedrijf. Twee jaar geleden hebben we onze data omgeving in Databricks volledig opnieuw opgebouwd, en die is helemaal klaar voor de toekomst. Er zijn weinig mooiere omgevingen om in te werken.

We zoeken een Data Analist met een duidelijke focus op product, die daarnaast onze marketing en commerciële teams ondersteunt met diepere analyses. Iemand met ervaring die klaar is om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, en die niet stopt bij een rapport maar actief stuurt op resultaat.

Wat ga je doen?

Je hoofdfocus ligt op product. Daarnaast ondersteun je marketing en de commerciële teams. Dat zorgt voor veel afwisseling in je werk.

Product

Binnen de markt van flexibel werk had je altijd de keuze tussen uitzenden of freelancers. Sinds afgelopen jaar zetten wij een propositie in de markt die daar tussenin zit: non-service uitzenden. De juridische zekerheid van uitzenden, met de flexibiliteit en eigen controle van freelancing via ons platform. Dit is een belangrijke stap in onze strategie naar one app for work.

  • In de lead zijn bij het tracken van de voortgang van deze nieuwe propositie;

  • De KPI's en funnel definiëren die laten zien of de propositie werkt;

  • De volledige journey van workers en opdrachtgevers analyseren, van onboarding tot herhaalde shifts;

  • Problemen vroeg signaleren en actief bijsturen waar jij ze ziet;

  • Inzichten samen met product en development vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;

  • Werken in een select team dat functioneert als startup binnen het bedrijf.

Commerciële & marketing ondersteuning

Naast product ben jij de analytische sparringpartner voor onze commerciële teams en marketing. Je gaat verder dan de standaard reports en duikt de diepte in wanneer vragen complex worden.

  • Diepere analyses leveren voor de commerciële teams, bijvoorbeeld op klant-potentie, retentie en groeikansen;

  • Marketing ondersteunen met inzicht in campagneresultaten en ROAS.

De functie is divers en afwisselend, maar bovenal krijg je veel vrijheid om te ondernemen.

Jouw team

Je wordt onderdeel van een effectief Data & RevOps team met 3 analisten, 2 engineers, een performance manager en 2 process analisten. Je rapporteert aan de Head of Data.

De data zelf is ook interessant: we ondersteunen een two-sided marketplace met workers aan de ene kant en opdrachtgevers aan de andere kant. AI zit in het ontwerp van hoe we werken en maakt de technische kant van je werk eenvoudiger. We werken met Genie binnen Databricks, dat onze data omgeving volledig snapt en kent, met Claude om meerdere systemen aan elkaar te koppelen en met Gemini voor snelle ondersteuning bij kleine taken.

Wat zoeken we?

We zoeken iemand die:

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring heeft als Data Analist, Product Analist of Commercial Analist;

  • Ervaring heeft met het tracken en sturen van product performance, en/of met commerciële of marketing analytics;

  • Sterk is in SQL en bekend is met Python/PySpark en een visualisatietool zoals Power BI of Amplitude;

  • Ervaring heeft met Databricks, of daar graag mee aan de slag wil;

  • AI tooling vanzelfsprekend inzet om sneller en slimmer te werken;

  • Eigenaarschap pakt, keuzes durft te maken en stakeholders weet te beïnvloeden;

  • Helder communiceert met zowel technische als niet technische collega's;

  • Al in Nederland woont en hier mag werken.

We zoeken geen profiel dat alleen reports oplevert. We zoeken iemand die de lead pakt, problemen eerder ziet dan anderen en zorgt dat er iets mee gebeurt.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een bruto salaris tussen €4.300 en €6.100 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • 25 vakantiedagen, 6,5 ADV-dagen en 1 extra feestdag per kalenderjaar, op basis van een 40-urige werkweek;

  • 8% vakantiegeld, een pensioenregeling en (als je meer dan 10 km van het kantoor woont) een reiskostenvergoeding;

  • We hechten veel waarde aan mentaal welzijn, in samenwerking met onze partner OpenUp;

  • Geweldige extra's zoals: een jaarlijks fitnessbudget, elke dag een vers bereide gezonde lunch, snacks, tweewekelijkse borrels in de middag, XL-borrels om de drie maanden, sporttoernooien en nog veel meer;

  • Een leidende rol in een nieuwe propositie die cruciaal is voor onze strategie;

  • Een van de beste data omgevingen om in te werken, met Databricks en AI ingebouwd;

  • Een bedrijf dat echt datagedreven is, waar jouw inzichten besluiten vormen;

  • Veel autonomie, vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

YoungOnes is een plek waar je snel leert, snel bouwt en snel resultaat ziet. Klaar om de lead te pakken? Dan horen we graag van je.

title: Security Advocate
description:
Summary of the Role:

Maze is a well-funded Series A startup using AI agents to fix vulnerability management for enterprise security teams. Our research team finds things worth talking about every week: how real vulnerabilities get exploited, which ones matter, and why most of the noise doesn't. We're hiring a Security Advocate to turn that work into explainers, videos, talks and posts that security practitioners actually want to read and watch.

This is a role for a security practitioner, not a marketer. You've worked in AppSec or cloud security, you can tell straight away whether a vulnerability write-up is right, and you can explain it in a way that's more interesting than a blog post. You'll be the face of Maze in the security community: on X and LinkedIn every day, on camera for our YouTube explainer series, and on stage at conferences. Some days, keeping up with what happened in security and talking about it will be the whole job, and that's fine with us.

You don't need a big following or a polished presenting style. We'll help with video production, editing and writing. What we can't teach is real security experience and the energy to show up in public and talk about it. Maybe you already post on the side but your day job leaves no time, or you've wanted to start and never knew how. Either way, this role gives you the time and support to do it properly.

Your Contributions to Our Journey:

  • Be the Credible Voice of Maze: Explain vulnerabilities, exploits and security news with enough depth that a CISO or Head of AppSec trusts what you say

  • Launch Our YouTube Explainer Series: Plan, script and present short explainer videos on the vulnerabilities and attack techniques security teams care about, from rough first episodes to a series people subscribe to

  • Turn Research into Content: Work closely with our product and research teams to turn their findings, and what we're building next, into write-ups, threads and videos that make sense for Maze and matter to the industry

  • Check the Technical Bar: Review our vulnerability write-ups for accuracy, then make them sharper and more interesting before they ship

  • Live in the Conversation: Be active on X and LinkedIn every day, following what's happening in security, reacting quickly and building real relationships with practitioners

  • Speak and Show Up: Give talks at conferences and community events, and occasionally join customer and prospect meetings to talk about the problem we're solving

  • Grow an Audience That Trusts Us: Your success will be measured by audience growth on YouTube, X and LinkedIn, the talks you land, and how often sales uses your content with prospects

What You Need to Be Successful:

  • Real Security Experience: 3-5 years as a practitioner in application security or cloud security. Engineering experience on its own isn't enough; you've done the security job

  • Credibility in the Room: Enough hands-on experience that senior security leaders take you seriously when you explain a vulnerability or an attack path

  • Comfortable in Public: Happy to put your face and name out there, whether that's on camera, on a conference stage or in a busy thread

  • Habitually Online: You already follow security news on X and LinkedIn closely and have opinions about what's happening

  • Clear Explainer: You can take a complicated technical issue and make it understandable and interesting, in writing and out loud

  • Energy and Charisma: You enjoy talking about security and it shows. Polish can come later

  • Self-Directed: You can set your own publishing rhythm and keep it going without being chased

  • Nice to have:

    • Experience at a fast-growing security or cloud company

    • Content you've already made, however small: posts, write-ups, videos, talks or podcast appearances

    • Experience in vulnerability research, penetration testing or bug bounty

    • Contributions to open-source security tools or communities such as OWASP

Why Join Us:

  • Ambitious Challenge: We're building at the intersection of generative AI (LLMs and agents) and cybersecurity, solving one of security's biggest problems: more vulnerability findings than teams can ever work through

  • Paid to Do What You'd Do Anyway: Following security news, breaking down vulnerabilities and talking about them in public is the job, not a side project

  • We'll Back You: Support with video production, editing and writing, plus first-hand access to our research team's findings

  • Expert Team: Work alongside a team of hands-on leaders with experience in Big Tech and Scale-ups, who have been part of the leadership teams behind multiple acquisitions and an IPO

  • Impactful Work: Cybersecurity is a force for good, and helping security teams understand real threats helps stop real attacks

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
Who we are:

At FRX Pennsylvania, exceptional cannabis begins with exceptional cultivation. As one of the largest Certified Kind cannabis cultivators in the United States, we are committed to growing cannabis with integrity, transparency, and an unwavering focus on quality. Because cannabis cannot be certified USDA Organic under current federal law, the Certified Kind program provides an independent, third-party verification modeled after internationally recognized organic standards. Through rigorous inspections and accountability, Certified Kind cultivators demonstrate their commitment to producing cannabis with respect for both people and the planet.

Everything we do starts with our living soil, which is an active ecosystem of beneficial bacteria, fungi, and other microorganisms that naturally cycle nutrients, support vigorous plant growth, and promote resilience. Rather than simply feeding the plant, we cultivate a thriving soil food web that allows each cultivar to fully express its unique cannabinoid and terpene profile while producing healthy, vibrant plants. By working with biological systems instead of relying on synthetic inputs, we produce cannabis that is true to its genetics and rich in the compounds that make every cultivar unique.

We proudly offer flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vaporizers, and edibles through our family of brands, including FRX, Anthos Organics, Common Citizen, Local Edibles, and Cannarocks. Every product reflects the same care, consistency, and attention to detail that goes into every harvest.

What we offer:

  • Compensation: $85,000-95,000
  • Health/Vision/Dental insurance coverage with HSA contribution plans
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 401K with 1% Match
  • Employee discounts
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid sick time

What the role is about:

The Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) serves as the primary HR partner for assigned Pennsylvania business units, providing strategic and operational HR support to leaders and team members. The HRBP partners closely with Executive Leadership and General Managers to drive talent acquisition, employee development, performance management, compliance, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness. This role serves as a trusted advisor, leadership coach, and change agent while ensuring compliance with company policies, Pennsylvania employment laws, and Pennsylvania cannabis regulations.

What impact you'll make:

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for Pennsylvania operations, including candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and hiring.
  • Review applications, conduct candidate screenings, and maintain detailed interview notes within JazzHR.
  • Partner with hiring managers to identify staffing needs and develop effective recruiting strategies.
  • Prepare and distribute offer letters while copying the HR Generalist, Director of Human Resources, and Payroll Department.
  • Train General Managers on interviewing best practices and participate in interviews as needed to ensure hiring consistency and quality.

Onboarding & HR Administration

  • Oversee onboarding activities for all newly hired employees within assigned Pennsylvania locations.
  • Administer Pennsylvania -specific compliance training, including Seed Talent learning management assignments.
  • Coordinate benefit enrollment and educate employees on available benefit offerings.
  • Train new employees on WURK, including timekeeping, self-service functions, and payroll procedures.
  • Ensure completion and accuracy of employment documentation, including I-9s, W-4s, and employee records within WURK.
  • Maintain accurate HR documentation while ensuring compliance with company policies and state regulations.

Employee Relations & Performance Management

  • Serve as the primary HR advisor to managers regarding employee relations matters.
  • Provide coaching and guidance on disciplinary actions, corrective action documentation, and performance management.
  • Facilitate and resolve routine employee relations concerns while escalating complex or high-risk matters to the Director of Human Resources when appropriate.
  • Review and co-sign termination requests with the Director of Human Resources prior to implementation.
  • Conduct exit interviews for voluntarily separating employees and identify trends impacting employee engagement and retention.

Leadership Development & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a strategic HR partner to Executive Leadership while mentoring and coaching General Managers.
  • Develop career pathway programs.
  • Drive employee engagement across all business unit levels, including processing employee inquiries and providing employee relations support in a timely manner and in a way that reflects the culture. Develop and execute initiatives to promote a culture that reflects HEART core values of Hard Work, Excellent Customer Service, (positive) Attitude, Respect, and Teamwork and build a culture that lives by the operating principals of Fast, Fresh, Full, Friendly, Fair, and Clean.
  • Advise and support team leaders on various topics, including employment law and government regulations, performance management, team morale, and various policies (e.g., FMLA, ADA, workers' compensation, etc.)
  • Lead organizational change initiatives by coordinating communication, implementation, and leadership training.
  • Maintain awareness of market-driven compensation trends in the industry
  • Coordinate and facilitate training sessions and seminars, facilitating training when needed.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Conduct quarterly on-site business unit evaluations to assess operational effectiveness, business unit culture and organizational cohesion, policy adherence, and consistency.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, Pennsylvania employment laws, and Pennsylvania cannabis regulations.
  • Monitor HR processes to identify compliance risks and recommend corrective actions.
  • Partner with leadership to improve organizational culture, efficiency, engagement, and workforce retention.

Organizational Development

  • Provide Executive Leadership and management with recommendations regarding organizational structure, staffing, succession planning, and retention strategies.
  • Identify areas where policy requires improvement to better serve the organization, propose solutions, develop initiatives, and implement change.
  • Identify opportunities to improve leadership effectiveness, employee engagement, and workplace culture.
  • Support strategic HR initiatives that align with organizational objectives and business growth.

Other Duties

  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support efficient, compliant, and employee-focused operations.

Position Requirements

  • This is a remote position but employee must be excited to travel weekly to regional business units.
  • Must be willing to use your own vehicle for weekly travel. Mileage is reimbursed at the IRS standard rate $0.725 per mile (2026).
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • Strong proficiency with modern office productivity platforms and business applications, including Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Teams, SharePoint, Forms), HRIS platforms, applicant tracking systems (Jazz HR, Indeed), and spreadsheet-based data management. Ability to quickly learn new software is essential.
  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including employee relations, leadership coaching, performance management, and talent acquisition.
  • Experience partnering directly with operational leadership across multiple business locations.
  • Strong knowledge of federal and state employment laws and HR best practices.
  • Experience with HRIS systems, applicant tracking systems, and learning management systems.
  • Ability to influence leaders, manage conflict, and build strong working relationships.
  • Experience in the cannabis, retail, and manufacturing industries is preferred but not required.
  • Working knowledge of safe work practices (OSHA, etc.) for all functions in a grower processor plant is preferred.
  • Must be able to pass the state mandated background check.
  • Excellent knowledge of employment law and other governmental requirements related to human resources
  • Demonstrated business acumen of HR KPIs; using data to drive continuous improvement
  • Excellent business communication and presentation skills

Physical and Environmental Requirements: 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  

  • Flexible schedule availability
  • Ability to stand/sit for extended periods of time 
  • Extended computer usage
  • Comfortable working under constant video surveillance
  • Work environments that include exposure to, but not limited to fumes, dust, odors, heights, indoor AC, no AC, motion, and noise. 

Management reserves the right to assign other job duties as necessary, with or without notice. Please note this job description is not designed to cover a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job.

Diversity and Inclusion: We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate based on race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, pregnancy, sex, gender identity or expression, disability, or because of the liability for service in the armed forces of the United States or the nationality of any individual, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. ​

As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

What you bring:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS.

  • A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end.

  • Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect â Professional.

    • Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS

    • Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS

    • Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS

    • Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code skills. Terraform is preferred; CloudFormation, AWS CDK or Ansible are also welcome.

  • Experience running containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or EKS.

  • Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls and VPN, plus AWS networking services such as VPC, Route 53, ELB and CloudFront.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You are confident with executives and engineering teams alike.

  • Comfort working in a distributed team, with a few hours of daily overlap with Central European Time.

title: Content Creator - YouTube
description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.


Compensation
  • Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
  • Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits
  • 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays
  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.
