title: Sleep Medicine Physician
description:
About Dreem Health, by Sunrise

Dreem Health is America’s leading digital sleep clinic. Powered by Sunrise’s technology, Dreem Health makes sleep care simple — replacing long waits and in-lab sleep studies with home-based testing, expert telehealth visits, and personalized treatment plans that are easy for patients to follow. We’re fixing the broken sleep care journey and helping more people get the care they need — from home, on their schedule.

Your Opportunity

As a sleep medicine physician at Dreem Health, you're transforming how sleep care is delivered by bringing high-quality, evidence-based treatment to patients through a modern, fully remote platform. Our clinical model offers the best of both worlds: the flexibility to work from home with no commute or unnecessary admin burden, and the opportunity to make a real impact at scale.

Unlike traditional sleep clinics where providers are often tied to 36+ hours of patient visits and limited in scope, our physicians focus primarily on HST interpretation alongside telehealth clinic hours, NP supervision, and contributing to the growth of our clinical model. You’re not just a cog in the wheel, you’ll help shape the way sleep medicine is practiced nationally.

We’re growing fast and on track to become the largest sleep provider in the U.S. If you're passionate about clinical excellence, excited by innovation, and interested in mentoring the next generation of sleep clinicians, Dreem Health is the place to grow your career.

What You’ll Do

  • HST interpretation: Read home sleep tests across our patient population in the states where you hold an active medical license. This is the core of the role.

  • Telehealth clinic hours (~8h/week): See patients directly, covering states where NP-led care is not yet available.

  • NP supervision: Hold collaborative practice agreements (CPAs) in your licensed states and provide clinical oversight to our NP team.

  • Continuous education: Participate in Dreem Health Academy sessions and contribute to NP learning.

What You Bring

  • M.D. or D.O. with a board certification in sleep medicine with preference of primary specialty in family medicine, pulmonology, psychiatry, ENT, neurology, or anesthesiology.

  • Must have sleep clinic experience, including HST interpretation.

  • Licensed in CA (required at hire); active or actively pursuing licenses in AR, OR, RI, AL, OK, LA and additional high-volume states. We support license applications and reimburse licensing fees.

  • Comfortable reading a high volume of HSTs autonomously.

  • Willing to hold collaborative practice agreements (CPAs) across multiple states.

  • Startup mindset: Scrappy, solutions-oriented, and hands-on, with robust clinical training and a “build, test, learn” approach and not bound by traditional care models.

  • Comfortable in navigating ambiguity, shifting priorities, and dynamic environments.

  • Proficient with EMRs, digital health tools, and telemedicine platforms.

  • A genuine affinity for improving healthcare access and patient outcomes

  • Can inspire teams, lead with vision, and guide clinical standards, even without formal authority.

  • Work well across teams and stakeholders (product, engineering, ops, marketing) and explain clinical insights in a clear, non-jargon way.

  • Open to feedback and co-creating processes with non-clinical teammates.

  • Remarkable communication skills.

  • Genuine interest in sleep, health, and helping people better understand and improve their well-being

Our Core Values

At Sunrise Group, we keep things clear and simple ✨, value trust and collaboration 🤝, and lead with optimism and compassion 🌞. These values guide everything we do.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful work that directly improves people’s lives
  • Be part of an international team across the US, France, Belgium
  • Annual team offsite
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • Continuing Medical Education (CME) to support your growth and ongoing professional development
  • FREE One Medical membership
  • 401(k) with company match
  • 20 days PTO + 10 paid holidays + 80 hours paid sick leave
  • Monthly phone and internet stipend

Compensation

$260,000 - $300,000 depending on experience.

We hire humans, not bullet points. Don’t meet every single qualification? That’s okay. We care more about who you are than what’s on your CV. We’re looking for people who are curious, resourceful, and ready to roll up their sleeves — especially if you’re excited about building something new in healthcare. So if you think you could make an impact here, reach out to us.

Compensation Range - Depending on Experience

$260,000—$300,000 USD

Dreem Health / Sunrise is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome people of all backgrounds and are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels included and respected. We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.

title: Nurse Practitioner
description:
About Dreem Health, by Sunrise

Dreem Health is America’s leading digital sleep clinic. Powered by Sunrise’s technology, Dreem Health makes sleep care simple — replacing long waits and in-lab sleep studies with home-based testing, expert telehealth visits, and personalized treatment plans that are easy for patients to follow. Your Opportunity

We’re hiring a Full-Time Nurse Practitioner to deliver exceptional sleep care as a vital member of Dreem Health’s clinical team. Reporting to a Lead Nurse Practitioner, you’ll screen, diagnose, and treat patients struggling with sleep issues, directly shaping their health outcomes and quality of life. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where clinical excellence meets patient-centered care.

  • A Patient-Focused Approach - This role requires a high level of empathy and understanding of patients' needs. You will strive to provide exceptional patient service and support throughout their care journey.
  • Excellent Communication Skills - Strong communication is key for interacting with patients, providers, and internal teams. Your ability to clearly relay complex medical information and accurately convey patient feedback is crucial.
  • Proactive, Innovative and Tech-Friendly - We seek a proactive, innovative thinker. You will identify areas for improvement, contributing to service enhancements.
  • Critical Thinking Skills - Always challenge the status quo. We can and we need to improve continuously the way we deliver care, and shape the patient experience
  • Prioritization Skills - In this multifaceted role, strong prioritization and time management skills are crucial. You will be tasked with juggling various responsibilities, ensuring seamless service delivery and optimal patient satisfaction.
  • Flexibility in the role - We need someone who has the ability and willingness to adapt to changing circumstances, environments, tasks, and requirements. It involves being open-minded, versatile, and responsive to the evolving needs of the job and the organization.

You’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in each patient’s health while contributing to a vibrant, supportive, and rapidly expanding clinical environment focused on redefining sleep health.

At Sunrise Group, we work on a problem that affects millions: poor sleep and untreated sleep disorders. Our mission is to make diagnosis and care easier to access, and we’re proud of the experience we provide to patients. We feel responsible for making it better every day. If you’re looking for the autonomy to take ownership of your work, make an impact, and be part of a team where ideas move fast and everyone has a voice - this role is for you!

What You’ll Do

  • Providing comprehensive sleep medicine care via telemedicine
  • Thoroughly documenting patient interactions using our customized EHR
  • Applying appropriate billing procedures
  • Participating in quality control and improvement activities
  • Returning patient messages and calls in a timely fashion
  • Facilitating referrals to other healthcare professionals and medical facilities
  • Keeping current with and following AASM guidelines and clinic medical protocols in your clinical care and decisions

What You Bring

  • A minimum of 5 years experience of direct patient care
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in sleep or sleep medicine is required for candidates who wish to start within one month.
    • Applicants without prior sleep experience must enroll in the Dreem Health Academy program — a paid, 4-week training course. Completion of this course is mandatory before beginning any work with patients.
  • A Master’s or Doctoral degree in nursing from an accredited college or university
  • A CA APRN License AND one or more additional state licenses are required
  • An active CA Furnishing license and an active DEA license (eligible to DEA license)
  • Preference for candidates that are multistate licensed with the one or more of the following states: AZ, CT, FL, GA, IN, NJ, PA, VA
    • additional state licenses a plus

At Sunrise Group, we keep things clear and simple ✨, value trust and collaboration 🤝, and lead with optimism and compassion 🌞. These values guide everything we do.

  • Annual team offsite
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

  • FREE One Medical membership
  • 401(k) with company match
  • 20 days PTO + 10 paid holidays + 80 hours paid sick leave
  • Monthly phone and internet stipend

$120,000 - $140,000 depending on experience.

We’re looking for people who are curious, resourceful, and ready to roll up their sleeves — especially if you’re excited about building something new in healthcare. So if you think you could make an impact here, reach out to us.

title: DRG Appeals Writer
description:
Overview

At Piedmont Healthcare, you’ll love a shared purpose, be motivated to be your best, and be recognized for your contributions. Piedmont Healthcare leaders are in your corner and invested in your success. Our wellness programs and comprehensive total benefits and rewards will meet your needs for today and help you plan for the future.

Responsibilities

The individual in this position on behalf of the entire Piedmont System will be responsible for managing the administrative appeal of reimbursement claims denied by Medicare or Medicaid on the grounds that the medical coding was incorrect. These duties involve coordination of activities with the managers of coding at each of the Piedmont affiliated hospitals and physician practices as well as the Senior Director of Government Appeals. The incumbent must maintain a high level of understanding of DRGs and MS/DRGs. ICD-9-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, American Hospital Association Coding Clinic guidelines, federal guidelines for coding Medicare inpatient records, state guidelines for coding Medicaid records, Utilization Review ("UR") regulations and Medicare guidelines regarding medical necessity, inpatient, outpatient and observation. In the context of managing the appeals, the incumbent will be responsible for resolving differences of opinions among coders as to the most appropriate code.The incumbent will be responsible for preparing the coding appeals; performing a detailed review, analysis and extraction of clinical and coding information from patient medical records and drafting effective narratives for Medicare and Medicaid appeals briefs in support of denied cases throughout appeals at all levels of the government appeals process. In addition, the incumbent will be qualified and available to testify in appeal hearing before an administrative law judge as an expert in medical coding.

Qualifications

Education
  • Bachelor’s Degree Required
  • In Lieu of degree six (6) years of relevant work experience will be accepted in addition to the experience requirement Required or
  • Coding Certificate program (AHIMA accredited) Preferred
  • Master’s Degree Preferred
Work Experience
  • 5 years of inpatient coding experience and of DRG-MS/DRG auditing experience in a healthcare setting Required
  • Experienced medical record/DRG coder/auditor with a working knowledge of ICD-10 guidelines, case management, government and contracted payers Required
  • Must be experienced in clinical, coding and patient financial services software such as 3-M Encoder, SCM / Quest, STAR, EPIC, Client Tracking, and I-Suites Required
  • In lieu of degree (, a total of eleven (11) years of experience ) Required
  • Experience in coding at a multi-facility organization and remote coding experience is a plus Required
  • Previous experience writing DRG Appeals Preferred
  • Previous experience with RAC claims denials Preferred
Licenses and Certifications
  • One or more certifications
  • RHIA - Registered Health Information Administrator Upon Hire Required or
  • RHIT - Registered Health Information Technician Upon Hire Required or
  • Health Services\CCS-Certified Coding Specialist Upon Hire Required or
  • CCA - Certified Coding Associate Upon Hire Required or
  • CCS-P - Certified Coding Specialist – Physician-based Upon Hire Required or
  • CPC-H - Certified Professional Coder - Hospital Outpatient/Facility Upon Hire Required or
  • CPC - Certified Professional Coder Upon Hire Required
  • Certified Coder-AHIMA or AAPC Preferred

title: Associate Producer
description:
Keywords Studios is looking for an organised and proactive Associate Producer to support the delivery of high-quality game-development projects on time and within budget.

Working closely with the Producer or Lead Producer, you will help coordinate multidisciplinary development teams, maintain project schedules, track deliverables, facilitate communication, and identify risks or dependencies that could affect production.

This role is well suited to someone with early production or project-coordination experience who is looking to develop their career within the video game industry.

Only those with relevant work rights for Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, the Philippines (Remote), or Singapore (on-site) will be considered. Sponsorship and relocation are not being offered as part of this package.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the Producer or Lead Producer in the planning, coordination and delivery of the assigned development project.
  • Assist the team in delivering a high-quality product on time and within the agreed budget and scope.
  • Help organise, execute and monitor project activities across one or more areas of development.
  • Prepare, maintain and monitor development schedules, task boards, project documentation and production reports.
  • Track progress against agreed milestones and follow up with team members on outstanding tasks, dependencies and deliverables.
  • Facilitate and chair regular team or sub-team meetings, ensuring that actions and decisions are clearly documented and communicated.
  • Maintain effective communication between development disciplines, project leadership, clients and other business stakeholders.
  • Support the preparation, review and submission of milestone deliverables to clients and internal management.
  • Identify production risks, blockers and resource constraints, and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Help remove impediments affecting the development team and support the resolution of cross-discipline dependencies.
  • Work with team leads to establish clear priorities, goals and expectations.
  • Help monitor team capacity, workload and productivity, highlighting potential issues before they affect delivery.
  • Support the onboarding and integration of new team members.
  • Contribute to retrospectives, project reviews and continuous improvements to production processes.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within the relevant production and project-management tools.
  • Promote open communication, collaboration and a positive working environment across the team.

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of experience in project coordination, production, project management or team coordination.
  • Previous experience supporting or coordinating a PC, console or live-operations game project is preferred.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Good working knowledge of productivity and project-management tools such as Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Jira, Hansoft, Confluence or Microsoft Project.
  • Ability to prepare and maintain schedules, task trackers, meeting notes, status reports and other production documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with multidisciplinary teams across areas such as art, design, engineering, QA and audio.
  • Ability to identify potential risks, dependencies and problem areas and raise them with the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Proactive, adaptable and able to work effectively in a fast-paced development environment.
  • Able to balance quality, scope, schedule, cost and team considerations when supporting production decisions.
  • Able to work independently while maintaining regular communication with project leadership.
  • A collaborative and supportive approach to working with team members and stakeholders.
  • An enthusiasm for video games and a good understanding of the PC and console gaming market.

Nice to Have:

Please let us know if you have experience in any of the following:

  • Scrum, Agile or other iterative project-management methodologies.
  • SAFe or another scaled Agile framework.
  • Live Operations or post-launch content delivery.
  • PC and console game development.
  • Console certification and submission processes.
  • Co-development or work-for-hire projects.
  • Working with distributed or international development teams.
  • Client-facing project coordination.
  • Supporting external development partners or vendors.
  • Relevant project-management training or certification.

Benefits

Our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) Commitment: Keywords Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, ethnicity, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. If you require any adjustments during the process please let us know in your application. We are committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation. We especially welcome applications from candidates of underrepresented groups in the industry.

This role serves as a senior technical contributor responsible for building high-quality platform functionality, developing user-facing portals, and supporting core ServiceNow capabilities aligned to mission and business needs. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on ServiceNow development experience, deep familiarity with portal technologies, and the ability to work collaboratively within Agile and SAFe delivery environments. This role requires a developer who can translate requirements into maintainable, performant ServiceNow solutions while adhering to federal standards and best practices.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, develop, and configure ServiceNow solutions to support federal program requirements
  • Build and maintain custom applications, workflows, business rules, and UI policies
  • Develop and enhance ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM and CMDB functionality
  • Design, develop, and support ServiceNow portals and web-based user experiences, including Service Portal and/or UI Builder
  • Collaborate with ServiceNow Architects to implement scalable, standards-based solutions
  • Participate in Agile and SAFe ceremonies, including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives
  • Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices
  • Support platform upgrades, patching, and performance tuning
  • Troubleshoot and resolve ServiceNow defects and production issues
  • Ensure configurations and customizations align with federal security and compliance requirements
  • Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing across the team
  • Other duties as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience
  • Strong experience developing custom ServiceNow applications and platform configurations
  • Proficiency with ServiceNow scripting (JavaScript, Glide APIs)
  • Experience working in Agile or SAFe delivery environments
  • Experience supporting the USCB in the last year
  • Ability to perform essential job duties and responsibilities, with or without reasonable accommodations.

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • ServiceNow Certified Systems Administrator (CSA)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)

SECURITY

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust
  • Pursuant to government contracts, U.S. citizenship is required.

PAY INFORMATION

The anticipated annual salary range for this position is $125,000 - $130,000. The final salary offered will be determined on a variety of factors, including the selected candidate's qualifications, experience, education, skills, internal equity, and market considerations, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. This salary range represents iTech AG's good faith estimate for this position at the time of posting, and not all candidates will qualify for the top of the range.

iTech AG is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

iTech AG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. title: Wedding Destination Planner
description:
Job brief

Join Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.

As a Remote Destination Wedding Travel Planner, you'll help couples turn their we do into an unforgettable travel experience. By combining travel planning expertise with a warm, consultative sales approach, you'll guide couples and their guests from the first wedding vision to confirmed bookings — whether it's a beachfront ceremony, an intimate European celebration, a luxury resort wedding, or a group getaway with family and friends.

What You'll Do

  • Design customized destination-wedding travel plans, including flights, resort stays, room blocks, transfers, cruises, excursions, and honeymoon extensions.
  • Connect with couples to understand their wedding vision, guest needs, budget, preferred destination, and non-negotiables—then present tailored options and confidently guide them through booking.
  • Coordinate travel details for wedding groups, helping ensure guests have clear booking options, payment timelines, and support before departure.
  • Respond to questions and changes with professionalism and care, including payments, room upgrades, guest additions, date changes, transfer needs, and special requests.
  • Elevate each celebration with meaningful details: romantic excursions, welcome experiences, local activities, honeymoon ideas, and unforgettable wow moments for the couple and their guests.
  • Support clients from the initial consultation through travel, including pre-departure communication, on-trip assistance, and post-wedding follow-up.

What You Bring

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills; comfortable guiding couples through decisions, answering concerns, and helping them confidently move forward.
  • The ability to organize multiple moving pieces, from guest lists and room options to payment schedules, travel documents, and group logistics.
  • A willingness to learn new tools, including CRMs, supplier portals, booking platforms, and group-travel systems.
  • A background in weddings, sales, customer service, hospitality, events, or travel is a plus—but it is not required. Full training is provided.
  • A genuine love for romance, celebrations, travel, and helping people create meaningful memories.

What You Get

  • A fully remote opportunity with part-time or full-time flexibility.
  • Comprehensive onboarding and continued coaching on destination weddings, preferred suppliers, resorts, group coordination, and sales-focused travel planning.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Room to grow and specialize in areas such as Caribbean weddings, luxury celebrations, honeymoons, cruises, all-inclusive resorts, or group travel.

Destination weddings involve many details—but if you are the person who enjoys bringing calm, clarity, and excitement to a couple's biggest celebration, you'll thrive in this role. You'll help turn wedding ideas into smooth travel plans, happy guests, and memories that last far beyond the ceremony.

Ready to join us and see where this path could take you?
Apply now — we'd love to meet you.

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
Role Summary

Alpha Lion is looking for an Amazon PPC Specialist to be the performance engine behind our paid and organic visibility on Amazon and Walmart. You'll own the marketing levers available on the marketplace — PPC campaigns, listing conversion, deals and promotions, and alignment with our DTC campaigns — and make sure every dollar of ad spend is tracked, tested, and optimized with precision. Your work will drive efficient, scalable growth and profitable revenue across our marketplace channels.

Responsibilities

  • Build, launch, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns on Amazon and Walmart to hit target ACOS, TACOS, and ROAS goals.
  • Use automation tools (such as Scale Insights) and bulk file operations to manage bids, rules, and keyword changes efficiently across the full catalog.
  • Run search term analysis, negative keyword mining, and keyword harvesting to sharpen targeting and cut wasted spend.
  • Improve listing conversion and organic ranking through structured A/B tests, content updates, and keyword strategy, working closely with our creative team.
  • Plan and execute deals, coupons, and promotions, keeping them in sync with DTC launches and hero product pushes.
  • Deliver weekly performance reports and post-event recaps that come with insights and recommendations, not just numbers.
  • Help build out Walmart advertising, applying what works on Amazon while adapting to the differences between platforms.

What Success Looks Like

  • You consistently hit or beat ACOS and TACOS targets while growing ad-attributed revenue quarter over quarter.
  • You run a self-sustaining PPC system, with automation handling the routine so you can focus on strategic improvements.
  • Your structured testing lifts conversion rates and improves organic rank on hero products without a proportional increase in ad spend.
  • Promotions go live on time and perform at or above forecasted lift.

Who You Are:

  • You have an extreme eye for detail. You catch keyword cannibalization, bid errors, and budget pacing issues before they hurt performance.
  • You think in systems: you document what works, build templates, and create repeatable processes.
  • You treat PPC as a business lever, not a task list, and connect every ad decision to revenue, margin, and brand outcomes.
  • You take ownership. When a metric trends the wrong way, you flag it and come with solutions, and you meet every deadline without reminders.
  • You play to win. You're not satisfied with "running ads" — you want to outperform the category and beat competitors.
  • You communicate proactively, sharing trends, risks, and wins without being asked

Experience & Skills:

  • 2–4 years of hands-on Amazon PPC management, with direct ownership of ad budgets and performance targets.
  • Proven experience with an ad automation tool (Scale Insights, Pacvue, Quartile, or Perpetua) for automation rules, bid management, and bulk optimizations.
  • Strong command of the Amazon Advertising console and Amazon CRO: A/B testing with Manage Your Experiments, keyword research (Helium 10, Data Dive, or similar), and listing optimization.
  • Experience planning and running Amazon promotions: lightning deals, coupons, best deals, and Prime Exclusive Discounts.
  • Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets, and a clear understanding of TACOS and contribution margin and how ad spend connects to profitability.

Nice to have:

  • Experience managing PPC for supplement, health and wellness, or CPG brands on Amazon (regulated categories a plus), ideally on high-revenue accounts in a DTC environment.
  • Exposure to Walmart Connect, and an Amazon Ads certification.

Why Alpha Lion:

Alpha Lion is a fast-growing, performance-driven brand focused on helping people unleash their Superhuman potential. We are building scalable systems, raising the bar on execution, and creating long-term competitive advantage in our category.

This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives, learn rapidly, and grow alongside a company that values ownership, curiosity, and results. If you’re excited by optimization, experimentation, and building systems that scale, Alpha Lion is a place where your work will matter.

Application Process

  • Apply: Submit your resume + a brief note explaining why you’d crush it in this role.
  • Screen: TA team reviews for skills and cultural alignment.
  • Cultural + Behavioral: In this step, you will take a personality assessment to see how you will perform in the role, then review it on a call with a cultural specialist here.
  • Interview: Conversations with the hiring manager and team.
  • Final Round: Case study or work simulation (role-specific).
  • Decision & Offer: We move fast — typically within 2–4 weeks.

Compensation:

We believe in competing at a high level — and that includes how we approach pay. This is a remote-first role, open to candidates anywhere in the U.S.

The expected base salary range for this position is 2.000-2,500(USD).

Your offer will reflect your experience, skill set, and where you live — we calibrate pay to ensure fairness and alignment with local markets.

Beyond base pay, team members may be eligible for performance bonuses, growth incentives, and benefits built to support their health, wellness, and professional goals.

title: Remote Customer Service Representative - Independent Contractor
description:
Company Description

ShyftOff is a flexible work platform that connects independent customer service professionals with leading brands across the U.S. With 26,000+ agents and growing, we're changing how people work by giving them more freedom, flexibility, and control over their earning potential.

Our platform offers 100% remote customer service opportunities, flexible scheduling in 30-minute increments, competitive compensation, and weekly payments. Whether you're looking for supplemental income or more consistent opportunities, ShyftOff makes it easy to find work that fits your life.

Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

Opportunity Description

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.

Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.

Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.
